creator: duncanrogoff
title: Three free design skills to stop the 'same AI look' (purple gradients, cards in cards): Anthropic's frontend-design skill, taste-skill (3 dials), and Impeccable (24 commands + 61 anti-AI-look rules)

tools.name: Frontend Design skill (Anthropic)
tools.detail: github.com/anthropics/skills shown on screen (178K stars badge); instructs Claude to act as design lead at a studio; rule 'spend your boldness in one place'

tools.name: taste-skill
tools.detail: Leonxlnx/taste-skill on screen (89.9K stars); three 1-10 dials: layout, motion, density

tools.name: Impeccable
tools.detail: pbakaus/impeccable (impeccable.style); 24 design commands e.g. /impeccable polish, bolder, quieter; 61 rules that scan a page for the AI look; built on top of the Anthropic frontend-design skill

claims: Without these skills every AI website looks the same: purple gradients, cards inside cards
taste-skill has ~89,000 GitHub stars (on-screen badge 89.9K); anthropics/skills shows 178K
Impeccable gives Claude 24 design commands plus 61 rules that scan your page for the AI look
Impeccable is built on top of Anthropic's frontend-design skill
All three are free and open source
how_to_steps: Install Anthropic's frontend-design skill from anthropics/skills so Claude designs like a studio lead and concentrates boldness in one place
Install taste-skill and set the three dials (layout, motion, density) from 1 to 10

Install Impeccable and use its commands (e.g. /impeccable quieter 'turn a loud design down without losing what it meant') and let its 61-rule audit catch the AI look (demo shows a purple 'Build the Future With AI Magic' hero flagged CAUGHT)
on_screen_only: Headline 'Why AI websites all look the same'; example hero 'Build the Future With AI Magic' (purple gradient) labeled SAME AI LOOK; dashboard screenshot labeled CARDS IN CARDS
01 Frontend Design: github.com/anthropics/skills, text 'Approach this as the design lead at ... distinct visual identity that is not mis...'
02 Taste Skill: taste-skill page, 89.9K stars; dial UI LAYOUT / MOTION / DENSITY each 1-10

03 Impeccable: impeccable.style tagline 'The missing design vocabulary for agents.'; command card '/impeccable quieter' with tags REFINE, FADER, 'Turn a loud design down without losing what it meant.'; stacked cards 'bolder', 'polish'
Closing slide 'All free & open source': anthropics/skills 178K, Leonxlnx/taste-skill 89.9K, pbakaus/impeccable (star count obscured, ends in K)

relevance.why: Haji ships app front-ends with Claude Code; a 40-second concrete stack of three free, well-starred skills that fix the generic AI look is directly usable and costs minutes to install.

implement_score.why: Install anthropics/skills frontend-design + pbakaus/impeccable (and optionally taste-skill) into the Claude Code skills folder; run /impeccable audit on existing app pages. Under 30 minutes; the Impeccable + taste pair is already endorsed in the liked set, this adds the official Anthropic skill as the base layer.

verify: Confirm the anthropics/skills repo actually contains a 'frontend-design' skill and the 178K-star figure (likely the whole repo, not the skill)
Confirm taste-skill repo is Leonxlnx/taste-skill and star count (~89.9K seems high; could be inflated)
Check whether Impeccable's '24 commands / 61 rules' matches the current README and that it declares a dependency on the Anthropic frontend-design skill
Test on one real page whether the three skills conflict (overlapping instructions can dilute each other)

gap.what: Liked set already covers Impeccable, taste-skill and awesome-design; new here is Anthropic's own frontend-design skill in anthropics/skills as the base layer Impeccable builds on, plus the specific 'spend your boldness in one place' rule and the 24-command/61-rule breakdown.
